title: ShareGPT4Video: Improving Video Understanding and Generation with Better Captions
authors_zh: Lin Chen, Xilin Wei, Jinsong Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Zehui Chen, Haodong Duan, Bin Lin, Zhenyu Tang, Li Yuan, Yu Qiao, Dahua Lin, Feng Zhao, Jiaqi Wang

one_line: ShareGPT4Video releases 40K long temporal captions and a captioner for scaling video-language supervision.
ShareGPT4Video 发布 4 万条长时序描述，并提供可扩展视频语言监督的描述器。
why: treating long temporally structured captions as the intermediate data engine for video instruction tuning
inclusion_reason: ShareGPT4Video is a public Track 01 training object: video id or frames, temporal event timeline, and a long detailed caption or derived instruction response; it is consumed by video-language pretraining and instruction SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Short video captions mention only the main action and omit temporal order, scene changes, camera motion, and object interactions needed for reasoning.

The paper's decision boundary is the released ShareGPT4Video training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains video id or frames, temporal event timeline, and a long detailed caption or derived instruction response; its selection boundary is caption detail/temporal consistency review and downstream video benchmarks, and the records are consumed by video-language pretraining and instruction SFT.

L4 facts: the official NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks page, public records at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ShareGPT4Video/ShareGPT4Video, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

短视频描述通常只说主动作，遗漏时间顺序、场景变化、镜头运动和物体交互。

该工作收集 4 万条详细描述，训练 ShareCaptioner-Video，并把时序事件描述用于视频理解和生成监督。 该方法直接产出 ShareGPT4Video。本卡的决策边界是可下载训练记录，而不是只有模型的报告或只用于评测的基准；单条记录包含 视频编号或帧、时序事件线以及详细长描述或派生指令回答。

L4 事实：已于 2026-07-27 核验 NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks 官方页面、https://huggingface.co/datasets/ShareGPT4Video/ShareGPT4Video 的实际公开记录、规模和条款。收录理由是论文中心贡献直接构造或筛选可序列化的后训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ShareGPT4Video collects 40K detailed captions, trains a scalable video captioner, and packages temporal descriptions that can supervise both understanding models and text-to-video systems. The closest comparison is WebVid-style short captions and frame-only visual instruction data; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is ShareGPT4Video and the feedback boundary is caption detail/temporal consistency review and downstream video benchmarks, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: diverse public videos sampled for temporal coverage. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing video id or frames, temporal event timeline, and a long detailed caption or derived instruction response advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: GPT-4V-assisted seed annotation followed by ShareCaptioner-Video produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply caption detail/temporal consistency review and downstream video benchmarks; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form 40,000 densely captioned videos in the public high-quality set stored as JSON metadata and downloadable video/caption archives and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for video-language pretraining and instruction SFT and compare against WebVid-style short captions and frame-only visual instruction data. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：该工作收集 4 万条详细描述，训练 ShareCaptioner-Video，并把时序事件描述用于视频理解和生成监督。 输出及流转：得到包含 视频编号或帧、时序事件线以及详细长描述或派生指令回答 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 4 万条公开高质量长视频描述，并提供可扩展描述器 以 JSON 元数据与可下载的视频和描述文件 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Replacing short captions with the detailed set improves video QA and captioning across multiple architectures; the captioner expansion shows that supervision quality transfers beyond the seed videos.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 39 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

在多个架构上，用详细描述替换短描述后，视频问答与描述任务均改善；描述器扩展说明高质量监督可离开种子集使用。结果仍受抽帧策略和视频来源分布限制。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 39 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: WebVid-style short captions and frame-only visual instruction data. The actual change is treating long temporally structured captions as the intermediate data engine for video instruction tuning. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect captioner errors may become consistent but false event narratives.
相对最近的共同做法，把长时序描述设为连接视频理解、指令微调与生成训练的中间数据引擎。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 描述器错误可能形成连贯但虚假的事件叙事。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Copyright stays with source videos
  2. automatic descriptions can miss brief events
  3. fixed frame sampling underrepresents audio and high-frequency motion.

1. 原视频版权并未因描述发布而消失。
  2. 自动描述可能漏掉短暂事件并编造一致但错误的事件线。
  3. 固定抽帧难以覆盖音频和高频运动。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For constructing temporal reasoning SFT records from public videos, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of captioner errors may become consistent but false event narratives.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: caption detail/temporal consistency review and downstream video benchmarks. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要从公开视频构造时序推理指令记录，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 描述器错误可能形成连贯但虚假的事件叙事。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
